title: [Decision] The authz census pins red main after a green merge, for the third time in ten days: run the static census files on PR and merge queue, make them a required local command, or derive the counts
body:
Ruled: 6433001130 · letter C only (re-ruled from A + C, 6432893116) · 2026-10-27T03:27Z


Filing gate ②: a maintainer-only decision. Option 1 adds a CI lane, which is a new gate (「新增门禁默认否」), and narrows the #24073 / #22653 ruling that keeps the dogfood legs off PR and merge-queue runs. The question was put on #26400 by `domain:spec` seat 1 (comment 6432031749), answering @os-zhuang's 「这种数字意义大吗？如何避免类似的问题。」. Maintainer, 2026-10-27: 「需要我决裁的问题，立决策卡」. Filed by the triage seat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

`packages/qa/dogfood` 里有两份权限普查测试，按条数钉住路由账本和 `rest-server.ts` 的注册点数。只要有人新增一条路由，就得同步改这两个数。但这两份测试只在 main 的 push 和定时任务里跑，PR 和合并队列都不跑，所以 PR 绿着合进去，main 才变红。10 天里第三次：#24057、#25988、#26361（这次红了 main 约 2.5 小时，p0 #26400，修复是 PR #26406）。请裁：**A** 加一条只跑这几份静态普查文件的 PR 和合并队列检查，几秒钟，只在改了路由文件时触发——这是新增门禁；**B** 不加 CI，让 dispatch-gates 把它们列为本地必跑命令，开发报告必须写已跑；**C** 把裸数字改成「从账本推导，只有未分类的路由才红」，纯数字变动不再红。选 A / B / C？可以 A+C。

## Premises (measured)

- P1. Three main reds of this class in ten days: #24057 (#24009), #25988 (#25956), and #26361 → #26400. Each time the PR that changed the counted file merged green.
- P2. The two files boot no app. `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` only reads source files; `authz-conformance.test.ts` adds one built package, `@objectstack/verify` (seat 1's reading).
- P3. `dispatch-gates --commands` already prints `⛔ does NOT run on this PR or in the merge queue` for a `packages/rest/src/**` path, and #26361's dev report still recorded `dogfood_battery: n/a`. The local warning exists and was missed.
- P4. While main is red, `full-battery` reads those runs and a release cut is refused.

## Options

| Option | What | Consequence | Workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | A PR and merge-queue job that runs only the static census files, path-triggered (`packages/rest/src/**`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/**`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-*`). The heavy dogfood legs stay off PRs (#24073 stands). | The red lands on the author's PR, in seconds. One more CI job, but only on those paths. | devx · 1 PR, Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`) · plus one required-context decision: advisory or required |
| **B** | `dispatch-gates` derives the census files as required local commands for those paths, and the seat's ACCEPT checks the dev report shows them run. | No CI cost. It depends on every dev and seat. The queue still cannot catch a miss, and P3 shows the warning was missed. | skills/devx · 1 PR (`scripts/pm/**`) |
| **C** | The census derives its population from the ledger and goes red only on a route that has no classification (`reachable` / `blindSpot`). | Bump-only reds (#25988 was a docblock `{@link}`) disappear. A real new route is still caught only after merge, unless A or B is also chosen. | devx · 1 larger PR (census rework) |

## Recommendation

**A + C.** A puts the check where the change is made. It runs in seconds and only on route files, so it is the narrowest gate that stops the class. C then makes the check measure the right thing: whether a new route has been classified, not how many routes there are. B alone would rely on the same local warning that P3 shows was missed. Because A is a new gate, it needs your explicit yes; without that, B + C is the fallback.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性：A+C 把一个「事后才红」的检查前移到 PR 上，并把裸计数改成按账本推导、看是否分类；不扩大 #24073 的范围，重型 dogfood 仍不上 PR。
② 实际业务拉动：10 天 3 次 main 变红，这次约 2.5 小时，期间发版被拒、每个带 `!` 的 PR 报告里都多出 10 个红。
③ 防 AI 犯错：A 在作者的 PR 上直接拒绝，响亮失败；B 依赖开发和席位记得跑，P3 证明这个提醒已经被漏过。
④ 创业阶段不扩散：A 是新门禁（默认否），只按路径触发、只跑几秒；C 是重写已有测试，不新增键。
Prior rulings read: dogfood PR merge_group skip · authz census → #24073 (closed), #22653; 「新增门禁默认否」; 「平台测试清单反复变红，肯定要修啊」; ADR none; thread: #26400 (6432031749)

## After the ruling

`domain:devx` dispatches the chosen letters. A is Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`), and the maintainer approves it at landing.
